description: How the revenue-organization roles relate to each other: who sets process and funds the platform, who approves deals and pays commissions, how accounts hand over from sales to service, and which signals flow back into revenue planning.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Commissioning platform capabilities and revenue programs

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day selling, deal approvals, handoffs, and platform provisioning

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Compensation, billing, and renewal money flows

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Pipeline, forecast, account health, and renewal-risk signals

relations.name: Sets sales process and territories
relations.description: Defines the sales methodology, stage exit criteria, territories, and quotas that guide how sellers work opportunities in the CRM.

relations.name: Feeds pipeline and forecast
relations.description: Keeps opportunities, stages, and close dates current so RevOps can inspect pipeline quality and commit an accurate forecast without chasing sellers for updates.

relations.name: Escalates pricing approvals
relations.description: Routes non-standard discounts and complex quote configurations up the approval chain that revenue leadership governs in CPQ.

relations.name: Pays commissions on attainment
relations.description: Calculates and pays seller commissions from closed-won data against comp plans, so attainment disputes are settled from the same system as the forecast.

relations.name: Hands closed accounts to service
relations.description: Hands over closed-won accounts with contract terms, entitlements, and deal context so service teams can support the customer from day one.

relations.name: Surfaces expansion and churn signals
relations.description: Shares case history, satisfaction trends, and product usage signals with account teams so sellers time expansion plays and rescue at-risk accounts.

relations.name: Reports renewal risk
relations.description: Feeds renewal-risk and service-escalation data into revenue planning so the forecast reflects accounts likely to churn or contract.

relations.name: Commissions platform capabilities
relations.description: Sponsors and prioritizes the platform roadmap — automation, Agentforce use cases, data quality programs — that the admin team builds and governs.

relations.name: Provisions seller workspace
relations.description: Provisions permissions, page layouts, automation, and integrations that keep account and opportunity data unified and reduce manual CRM work for sellers.

relations.name: Deploys service channels and agents
relations.description: Configures omnichannel routing, case automation, and policy-aware AI agents that the service operation runs on, within release and governance guardrails.
